races.name: Cumberland Show Saturday 6th June Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tap Tap Shamie

runners_data.name: Dream On Mick
runners_data.note: Lightly raced and unproven style from modest Kirby yard, long absence since pulled-up run raises concerns

runners_data.name: Jet Noir
runners_data.note: Front runner who fades late but gets uncontested lead here, poor trainer record suggests limited improvement

runners_data.name: Patrick's Wells
runners_data.note: Returns after 882-day absence with fade-in-finish tendency, completely unknown quantity after lengthy break

runners_data.name: The Shanachie
runners_data.note: Lightly raced type with consistent finishing position but lacks any winning form to date

runners_data.name: The Grey Venture
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late from weak Bewley stable, recent form suggests limited ability

runners_data.name: Maccarellu
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from top Venetia Williams yard, excellent soft ground record with 8 runs showing consistency

runners_data.name: Aristelle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 7lb weight allowance for conditional jockey, previous third on soft ground shows ability

runners_data.name: McElhattan
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from in-form Donald McCain stable, recent run suggests returning to form after break

runners_data.name: Last Man Standing

races.paceDynamic: Jet Noir is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate from the start, with Tap Tap Shamie and Maccarellu likely to race prominently behind. The pace will be sustainable rather than frantic, as there's minimal early pressure on the leader. A large contingent of hold-up horses including Aristelle, McElhattan, The Grey Venture and Last Man Standing will look to come from off the pace. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine but not excessive pace will create a strung-out field perfect for closers to pick off the front runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace allows closers to save ground and finish strongly
scenarios.body: The large hold-up contingent will benefit from the uncontested early pace as Jet Noir leads comfortably. Late runners like Aristelle and McElhattan can unleash their finishing kicks over the final 3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie or Maccarellu can sit handy and outstay the leader
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers will track the pace perfectly and have enough left to resist the late charge. Their tactical position gives them first run on the weakening leader while the closers have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Noir gets soft sectionals and the ground plays to stamina types
scenarios.body: The leader will steal several lengths early and maintain a rhythm that the closers cannot reel in. The testing ground and trip will play to his staying power despite his tendency to fade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced horses shows unexposed improvement
scenarios.body: Dream On Mick or The Shanachie will benefit from the tactical setup while having more ability than their limited form suggests. The pace collapse will bring them into contention despite their inexperience.

watchPoints.text: Jet Noir could get too easy a lead if the prominent racers don't press early enough
Maccarellu returning after 118-day break for struggling Venetia Williams stable may need the run
Dream On Mick's jockey booking suggests stable confidence despite limited public form
Several horses carry finishing concerns including Patrick's Wells and The Grey Venture who may not stay the trip
Aristelle gets significant weight relief with 10lb conditional jockey which could prove decisive

races.name: Feel Good Friday 29th May Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: I Wish You
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong RPR of 126 but faces 37-day layoff, though trainer Russell/Scudamore have decent 14-day strike rate.

runners_data.name: Big Zouk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off a Hexham win 50 days ago, but Nicky Richards has modest recent form with just 2/16 winners.

runners_data.name: Benmore
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who won at this course last time out in similar conditions, giving him a clear tactical advantage despite trainer Morgan's poor 0/4 record.

runners_data.name: You Some Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with excellent course record (4W5P from 15 runs on good ground) but faces 99-day absence and has claiming jockey William Maggs taking 3lbs off.

runners_data.name: Orkney Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up type in good form with recent Hexham win, though trainer Alexander is 0/11 in last 14 days and faces consistent underperformance.

runners_data.name: Eaton Anne
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with good recent form and Olly Murphy's strong 7/22 strike rate, plus Sean Bowen booking suggests stable confidence.

runners_data.name: Loulou Madrik
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent recent form and the youngest in the field at 5, though trainer Walford has modest 2/24 record.

races.paceDynamic: Benmore is the sole confirmed pace-setter, giving him a tactical edge as he won't face early pressure and can dictate terms from the front. Big Zouk and Loulou Madrik will likely sit prominent behind Benmore, but neither are natural pace-pressers. The majority of this field are hold-up horses (I Wish You, You Some Girl, Orkney Blue, Eaton Anne) who will need Benmore to go fast enough to set up their finishing kicks. This setup moderately favours the front-runner and prominent racers — Benmore can control the gallop without pressure, and if he goes too slow, the hold-up brigade may struggle to pick him up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Benmore Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore gets away with a steady gallop and isn't pressured early.
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized, with his recent Carlisle win showing he handles this track well. The prominent runners like Big Zouk get first run at him but lack the pace to reel him in.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore goes fast enough early to set up a genuine staying test.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the strong pace they need, with I Wish You and You Some Girl having the class and stamina to mount late challenges. Orkney Blue's recent Hexham win shows he's in form to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Punch Home
scenarios.trigger: If Big Zouk or Loulou Madrik can get close enough to Benmore without over-racing.
scenarios.body: They can use their handy positions to strike turning for home before the back-markers organize, with Big Zouk's Hexham win and Loulou Madrik's consistent form suggesting both are competitive. The hold-up horses leave their run too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Benmore goes off too fast early and the field bunches up for a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with any horse capable of winning, though the younger legs of Loulou Madrik and fitter horses may have an edge. This scenario suits no particular profile and creates chaos.

watchPoints.text: If Benmore gets an easy lead and dictates a slow pace, the hold-up horses will struggle to peg him back on the long Carlisle straight.
You Some Girl's 99-day break is a concern despite her excellent course record, and the claiming jockey booking suggests connections aren't fully confident.
Big Zouk's 50-day gap since his Hexham win could leave him short of peak fitness against these fresher opponents.
Trainer form is mixed with Morgan (0/4), Alexander (0/11) and Walford (2/24) all struggling recently, while Murphy (7/22) stands out positively.
The good ground plays to You Some Girl's strengths based on her course record, but she needs the pace to develop properly from her hold-up style.

runners_data.name: Guernesey

runners_data.name: Maura Jeanne

runners_data.name: Robert d'Ores

runners_data.name: Ballin Bay

races.paceDynamic: Kyntara, Rocheval, and Ballin Bay will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-sapping 3m1f trip. Kyntara is a natural front-runner with solid form at the distance, while Rocheval and Ballin Bay both have the pace to press or lead early. This trio will string the field out over the extended trip on testing ground, creating a genuine end-to-end test. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina — the pace is genuine and those held up can pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too hard early and come back to the field
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out the front three over this extended trip, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Horses with stamina reserves and tactical speed will benefit most from the strong setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Ballin Bay or Kyntara can control the tempo and see off rivals
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters manages the fractions cleverly and has enough left to resist late challengers. Recent form suggests Ballin Bay has the class edge to make all pay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Ramo or Guernesey track the pace and strike turning in
scenarios.body: The prominent runners time their move perfectly as the leaders weaken, getting first run on the hold-up horses. Their tactical positioning allows them to capitalize before the back-markers can respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders engage in an early speed duel and neutralize each other
scenarios.body: The pace-setters go hammer and tongs early, creating carnage up front and allowing a maiden or outsider to profit. The race becomes tactical as jockeys panic about the early pace.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Kyntara, Rocheval and Ballin Bay all commit to leading early as this could create unsustainable fractions
Watch Jupiter Des Mottes' position turning for home as he needs the strong pace to set up his finishing kick
Watch for Adveram's market moves as first-time cheekpieces and light weight suggest stable expects improvement
Watch Ramo's early positioning as he needs to track the pace without getting involved in any early speed battle
Watch Dr Seb late in the betting as Murphy's 7/22 strike-rate suggests confidence when they fancy one

races.paceDynamic: Rock N Roll Champ will set the pace uncontested, with his 5lb claimer Edward Austin able to dictate comfortable fractions on the front end. The prominent runners Gonnino, Takeyoutotheisland and Blended Stealth will track behind but none are aggressive pace pressers, allowing a measured gallop. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Sattam, Kicksaftersix, Gone With The Tide, Je Mr Dawson, Belvedere Bhoy and King Kodiak will be held up for late challenges. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be modest and there's plenty of ammunition being held in reserve for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Champ sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as the leaders come back to the closers in the final furlong. The best hold-up horses with superior ratings sweep past tired pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gonnino or Takeyoutotheisland can position ideally behind the leader and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: They get first run on the field before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. The tactical positioning proves decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rock N Roll Champ Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's 5lb weight allowance and uncontested lead combine with the field being too patient
scenarios.body: He builds an unassailable advantage while the field dallies, with Edward Austin's claim proving decisive. The closers leave their runs too late to peg back the honest front-runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the modest early pace completely falls apart and causes a sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: Fitness and class become secondary to who gets the clearest passage in a bunched finish. An outsider with the right trip can capitalize on the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Rock N Roll Champ could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions - monitor early pace pressure from prominent horses
Kicksaftersix hasn't run for 294 days but has excellent fresh record - watch for market confidence late
Sattam carries highest RPR but 42-day break could blunt sharpness in competitive handicap
Gone With The Tide has pulled up twice recently - fitness and enthusiasm must be questioned
First-time cheekpieces on Rock N Roll Champ and King Kodiak suggest stable concerns about focus

races.paceDynamic: Lord De Vinci and Blazing Court will set the early pace, but neither is a true tearaway front runner, creating a moderate gallop rather than breakneck speed. With eight of the ten runners adopting hold-up tactics, there's a serious lack of early pace which will likely result in a steady tempo that quickens dramatically from the final hurdle. The prominent horses will dictate throughout without serious pressure until the business end. This setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems — the lack of genuine pace means hold-up horses will struggle to pick up the pieces in time.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lord De Vinci and Blazing Court are allowed to bowl along unchallenged
scenarios.body: The pace will be comfortable throughout allowing both to save energy for a sustained finish, with the hold-up brigade trapped behind them as they kick clear. Their tactical advantage becomes decisive when the field bunches up turning for home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes back to the leaders
scenarios.body: A cavalry charge develops from the back with traffic becoming crucial, favoring the best jockeys on horses with tactical speed. The race becomes a sprint finish where class and form tell.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hobnail Shows Early Speed
scenarios.trigger: If Hobnail breaks his recent fading pattern and travels strongly throughout
scenarios.body: His prominent style could unsettle the other pace angles and create a faster gallop that sets up the hold-up horses perfectly. However, his recent form suggests he's more likely to weaken than win.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Absent Hang On Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hang On's 837-day absence masks a fitness edge and Joel Parkinson has him spot-on
scenarios.body: The veteran could use his experience to find the perfect position and strike late, but the lengthy break makes this a huge ask. His hold-up style needs the pace to be stronger than it's likely to be.

watchPoints.text: Lord De Vinci could get an uncontested lead if Blazing Court doesn't go with him early, making him very hard to peg back
Traffic problems at the final hurdle could be crucial with so many hold-up horses needing room to challenge
First-time headgear on Au Plaisir, Shouldvebeenshav, and Hobnail suggests connections are looking for improvement
Blazing Court's 109-day absence could tell late despite the first-time tongue-tie and trainer booking his son to ride
Rebecca Menzies' 10% strike rate from twenty runners suggests Au Plaisir is trained to the minute despite the hood debut

races.paceDynamic: Voleur De Terres is the only confirmed front runner and will control the gallop from the outset, with Steal The Moves and Tory Hill providing some early pressure from prominent positions. This creates a moderate but sustainable pace with the large field of hold-up horses tracking behind - Super Citizen, Girls Best Friend, Baptism Of Fire, Jamesieconn, Kingofthegame and Don Brocco all need to be delivered late. The lack of early pace pressure means the leaders won't be softened up significantly. This setup moderately favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and have first run on the wall of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Voleur De Terres and the early pace-setters maintain a steady gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows the prominent runners to stay in touch and kick first when the hold-up horses are still finding their rhythm. Steal The Moves and Tory Hill benefit from tracking the pace and getting first run on their higher-rated but more hold-up reliant rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely searching and the leaders weaken in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and creates the perfect setup for a well-timed late challenge from the back. Super Citizen or Girls Best Friend can use their class advantage when delivered with a perfectly-timed run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Voleur De Terres goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the last mile
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a bunched field turning for home where positioning becomes crucial and the fastest finisher wins. This tactical affair could see any horse win if they get the right run at the right time.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the ground conditions or distance despite the ratings suggesting otherwise
scenarios.body: The combination of returning from a break, ground conditions, or jumping errors eliminates the favourites leaving the door open. Kingofthegame or Don Brocco could capitalize on a race that falls apart.

watchPoints.text: Super Citizen jumping early fences - any mistakes could end his chances given his hold-up style requires a clean round
Voleur De Terres setting the early pace - if he goes too fast he'll compromise his own chances and setup the hold-up horses perfectly
Girls Best Friend and Jamesieconn in the market - both represent yards with recent winners and their price movements will indicate stable confidence
Baptism Of Fire's jumping throughout - returning from a break after poor efforts and any early mistakes will effectively end his race
The weight-carrying performances of Steal The Moves and Kingofthegame - both get significant weight relief which could transform their chances

races.paceDynamic: Ryebridge will make the running with Micks Jet and Moyganny Phil pressing from the outset, creating a solid tempo over this extended trip. The presence of three natural prominent runners ensures a true gallop that will stretch the field, particularly on soft ground which already tests stamina. With seven hold-up horses including class act Two Brothers and recent winner Las Canals, the majority of the field will be coming from off the pace in the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out, allowing patient riders to pick off tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three prominent runners maintain a strong tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will stretch Ryebridge, Micks Jet and Moyganny Phil, allowing the patient brigade led by Two Brothers and Las Canals to sweep past in the closing stages. The soft ground compounds the stamina test, making this a tactical race for those held up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Three Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ryebridge sets unsustainable fractions under pressure from Micks Jet and Moyganny Phil
scenarios.body: All three prominent runners will weaken dramatically in the final furlong, leaving the race to the strongest finisher from the pack. Two Brothers' class and Sean Bowen's switch to Moyganny Phil suggests connections expected this pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ryebridge Stays Strongest
scenarios.trigger: If Danny McMenamin can dictate a more controlled tempo from the front
scenarios.body: The recent Carlisle winner gets an uncontested lead and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges, particularly with his proven course form. His last victory came in similar conditions and he's proven he can quicken when pressured late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moyganny Phil Times It
scenarios.trigger: If Sean Bowen tracks Ryebridge before making his move at the second-last
scenarios.body: The booking of champion jockey Sean Bowen for Olly Murphy suggests stable confidence, and Moyganny Phil's prominent style allows him to stay closer to the pace than most. His recent form shows consistent placings in similar company.

watchPoints.text: Ryebridge could get an easy lead if Micks Jet and Moyganny Phil are not aggressive enough early, completely changing the race dynamics.
Two Brothers carries a significant weight penalty at 173lbs but his class advantage could still prove decisive if the pace is strong enough.
Micks Jet's 349-day absence is concerning despite Philip Kirby's good recent form, watch for signs of rustiness in the early stages.
Sean Bowen's booking for Moyganny Phil over other available rides suggests Olly Murphy expects a big run from his consistent performer.
First-time headgear on Heritier (tongue-tie) and Wind Your Neck In (cheekpieces) could spark improved efforts from both hold-up horses.

runners_data.name: Kado Sacree
runners_data.note: Sean Bowen booking suggests Olly Murphy expects improvement after 59-day break, hold-up horse with perfect soft ground record but disappointing recent form.

runners_data.name: Half Track
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer for in-form claimer Dominic Hislop, gets significant weight relief but has been off since November.

runners_data.name: Red Cadillac
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent soft ground record for Nicky Richards, recent winner and consistent performer who should be competitive off 169lbs.

runners_data.name: Devon Skies
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with three wins from last five starts for Philip Kirby, pulled up last time but previous form suggests he handles these conditions well.

runners_data.name: Rauzan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trained by Lizzie Quinlan returning quickly from recent third, first-time cheekpieces applied suggest they want to sharpen him up.

runners_data.name: Yapper Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should track the leader, tongue-tie retained and comes here fresh off a reasonable fourth for the Bewley team.

runners_data.name: Tarbuck
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 70-day break for Claire Dyson, likely to get uncontested lead but needs to prove his stamina at this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Tarbuck is the only natural pace-setter in this field and should get an easy lead with Yapper Hill likely to track in second. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will settle towards the rear, creating a compressed bunch behind the front two. With soft ground conditions at Carlisle's stiff 2m3½f trip, the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing the leaders to dictate throughout. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — they'll get the strong gallop they need and can time their challenges from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tarbuck sets a steady pace and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The soft ground and trip will suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade. The closing stages will see multiple challengers emerge from the pack to reel in the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front two fight it out
scenarios.trigger: If Tarbuck and Yapper Hill get too far clear early
scenarios.body: The leaders will have enough in reserve to hold off late challenges on this testing ground. Yapper Hill's prominent style gives him the tactical edge over Tarbuck's leading role.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Tarbuck goes too slow and nobody wants the lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the turn with positioning crucial rather than stamina. Those with the best turn of foot will benefit from the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early pace battle develops
scenarios.trigger: If Yapper Hill or another decides to press Tarbuck from the start
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo will set up an even stronger finish for the hold-up horses. Those who settle best will have the most left for the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Tarbuck could set too slow a pace early and be vulnerable to hold-up horses with superior finishing kicks.
Devon Skies pulled up last time out so needs monitoring for any repeat of those issues despite his previous good form.
Kado Sacree has disappointed in his last four runs but Sean Bowen's booking after a break could signal a return to form.
Red Cadillac's recent win and consistent soft ground form makes him a key player in the hold-up battle.
Half Track gets 7lb claim from Dominic Hislop but the 67-day absence since his last run needs factoring in.
